about: Every game the mashup needs, its role in the Melty recipe and what it brings. Nothing from any game is shipped; each is read from the player's own install.

rows.name: Minecraft: Java Edition
rows.route: Fabric Loader mod in a bundled portable Prism Launcher instance (mmc-pack.json names Fabric; Prism installs it on first start)
rows.brings: the world, survival, mining, crafting, multiplayer hosting

rows.name: Scrap Mechanic
rows.engine: Axolot in-house engine (Lua scripting, JSON shapesets)
rows.route: read its JSON shapesets, English language files and TGA/DDS textures from the player's install at start
rows.brings: the building parts: block materials, thruster, driver's seat, with their real names, textures, colours and physics materials

rows.name: No Man's Sky
rows.engine: Hello Games in-house engine (HGPAK archives, MBIN data, Wwise audio)
rows.route: read GAMEDATA/PCBANKS HGPAK archives (zstd chunks) from the player's install: English localisation MBINs and Wwise Vorbis WEM music converted to Ogg in memory
rows.brings: planet music (its own soundtrack), planet descriptors (biome and weather words) and the proper-noun vocabulary planet names are generated from
